note: Remote, shaded Forest Service campground in the Little Missouri National Grassland badlands, about 15 miles west of US 85 on gravel Magpie Road. The Maah Daah Hey Trail trailhead is half a mile south; horses are allowed at every site. --Claude
summary: USFS page read: open, 8 spurs, $10, FCFS only, 14-day limit, no electric, hand pump spring-fall, vault toilet, year-round. Groups written; note cleaned. Not on rec.gov. Pin ok; not waterfront stands. No alert for Magpie Road.
flags: HORSES: 'Horses permitted at all sites' - a general campground where horses are allowed, not a separate horse camp (no equestrian-only sites). Keep.
FIT: the FS page states no pad length. Access is about 15 miles of gravel Magpie Road from US 85; the FS gives no road warning and the alerts page has no closure for it.
PIN: stored 47.30806,-103.47333 equals the FS page's point and sits on the camp spurs: ok.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Magpie Creek (a narrow channel, well under 30 m) loops ~40 m east/north of the nearest spurs, but through continuous tree cover; no open-ground creekside apron at any spur.
PHONE: keep 701-227-7800 (Medora Ranger District on the FS page). WEBSITE: keep the FS page.
